reason: GPTFootprint is a browser-extension awareness intervention that estimates LLM water/energy per ChatGPT query and prompts breaks. A one-week study with nine participants increased awareness but had limited success reducing usage. It changes user behavior, not LLM inference compute/latency/memory/serving; linked green-inference relation is motivation-level only.
title: GPTFootprint: Increasing Consumer Awareness of the Environmental Impacts of LLMs
